review_mode: read_only_critic; current Blender and Unreal scenes were not executed or edited
target: Arin: friendly adult woman, semi-real stylized RPG NPC; chestnut side braid, warm coherent skin, readable eyes and fitted travel costume

evidence.view: generated front design reference; style and identity, not calibrated anatomy
generated original Arin concept; style and identity

invariants_to_preserve: 1.70 metre full assembly height and grounded feet; metres, Z up, front -Y
Actual volumetric human geometry and continuous chestnut hair coverage; do not regress to a silhouette projection
Arin identity: adult woman, chestnut side braid, green eyes, ivory and green traveling clothes, leather accessories and red potions
Editable durable Blender/Python source; preserve complete v1 separately before modifying source
Existing rig hierarchy and Idle action must keep working unless the root contract explicitly extends them
All deform weights finite and normalized; retain the actual FBX fresh-import gates and engine integration
Material slots/names and runtime asset identities remain stable or are migrated explicitly
Identical cameras, framing, render settings and required poses for before/after comparison

deterministic_gate_summary.limitations: These metrics prove the existing asset's geometry/export/Idle operation; they do not prove facial likeness, anatomical form, grip support or large-pose deformation.

critical_requirement_ledger.observation: The primary character is readable and fully three-dimensional; nose, chin, rear skull and torso have profile depth. The result is an adult NPC at gameplay scale.
critical_requirement_ledger.source_cause: Shaped ring meshes and actual independent geometry replaced the previous silhouette approach.
critical_requirement_ledger.proposed_source_fix: Preserve the full 3D construction and world dimensions throughout refinement.
critical_requirement_ledger.acceptance: Recheck matching full-body front/profile/back/three-quarter and fresh-FBX views after the last source change.

critical_requirement_ledger.observation: The closeup reads as a generic smooth doll: a long narrow lower face, tall arched blank forehead, staring pale sclera and tiny lifted mouth. It lacks the reference's full cheek volume, expressive eye/iris relationship and relaxed warm smile.
critical_requirement_ledger.source_cause: A uniform latitude cranium plus isolated eye/lip/brow islands establishes generic placements, with limited cheek/muzzle and expression structure.
critical_requirement_ledger.proposed_source_fix: Re-establish face proportions from the new root-approved reference board before detail. Shape cheekbone, cheek pad, jaw/chin, brow and muzzle together; soften the hairline arch and use subtle asymmetric expression. Adjust eye/iris relationship with the eyelid topology, rather than independently enlarging disks.
critical_requirement_ledger.acceptance: Fixed face front and both three-quarter/profile closeups, plus full-body identity comparison under matched light. Proportion changes must remain deliberate stylization; generated references are not precision anatomy measurements.

critical_requirement_ledger.observation: Each white almond has a conspicuous double raised skin outline and a separate lower pouch; eyelids read as rims applied above the face rather than anatomical skin folding around an embedded eyeball.
critical_requirement_ledger.source_cause: _almond_eye, _orbital_skin and _eyelids are separate closed components. Orbital bands have only inner/outer boundaries and the lid is an elliptical tube; their vertices and normals do not form continuous skin with _head_surface.
critical_requirement_ledger.proposed_source_fix: Replace the skin rim/annulus islands with a continuous face patch containing actual eye apertures and three concentric eye-socket loops. Seat full spherical eyeballs behind the apertures, use thin upper/lower lid volumes and a gentle crease flowing into cheek and brow; offset poles from eye corners. Keep sclera, iris, pupil and cornea separate as appropriate.
critical_requirement_ledger.acceptance: Front/profile/three-quarter macro views under clay and skin materials; no raised double rim or visible gap. Test blink/eye-close if facial controls are added to the contract, with no intersection or volume collapse.

critical_requirement_ledger.observation: Nose tip/alar details are simplified and the two nostril dots look like tiny applied pink marks. Lips look like small separate ribbons, and the visible ear has little internal form.
critical_requirement_ledger.source_cause: The nose is a Gaussian displacement field in coarse latitude bands; nostrils are projecting lip-material disks. Upper/lower lips are closed standalone strips; the ear is a bean disk with a single radial ridge.
critical_requirement_ledger.proposed_source_fix: Model bridge/tip/alar-wing/columella transitions with continuous nose loops and enclosed recessed nostril cavities. Integrate upper/lower lips and corners into the muzzle with a real commissure and Cupid's bow; build an oral cavity only if the resolved facial contract needs jaw opening. Add restrained helix/antihelix/concha/lobe form to ears.
critical_requirement_ledger.acceptance: Matched front, both profiles and oblique face/ear closeups. Lips and nostril interiors remain naturally coloured and seated; surface normals flow continuously into surrounding skin.

critical_requirement_ledger.observation: The current head is rigidly weighted to one head bone. The source has broad horizontal rings with isolated face components, not a continuous expression-ready eye/mouth/jaw flow. Static form can be improved now; required facial controls remain a root contract decision.
critical_requirement_ledger.source_cause: Rigid arin_bone=head is assigned to every face feature; BuildArin.py has no facial bones/shape keys. _head_surface's latitude grid does not surround real eye or mouth openings.
critical_requirement_ledger.proposed_source_fix: Retopologize the chosen face form into quad-dominant skin before rigging facial deformation. Use three eye loops, a jaw-following loop and two brow loops; reserve six to eight mouth loops only if dialogue/lip sync is required. Keep poles on scalp/back-neck or inside oral cavity, not at moving corners.
critical_requirement_ledger.acceptance: Record the resolved facial scope first. If expressions are included, inspect blink, smile, jaw open, brow raise and frown separately and in combinations, then repeat on a fresh export. A joined object is not proof of a connected skin surface.

critical_requirement_ledger.observation: The revised cap covers the crown, temples and back consistently. The formerly exposed bald scalp patches are absent in the actual source and FBX views.
critical_requirement_ledger.source_cause: _scalp now fits interpolated real cranial ring dimensions with an outward allowance.
critical_requirement_ledger.proposed_source_fix: Retain fitted cap clearance and coverage while reshaping hair masses; do not restore the smaller ellipsoid cap.
critical_requirement_ledger.acceptance: Matched front/back/profile/top and both three-quarter hair views; verify evaluated hair-to-cranium clearance and visible absence of bald patches.

critical_requirement_ledger.observation: The crown/back is a glossy smooth helmet with a few large raised locks. The gathered section beside the neck is a smooth bean-shaped mass ending abruptly at the braided strands, which read as an open mechanical helix. This is weaker than the reference's connected swept chestnut coiffure and natural plait.
critical_requirement_ledger.source_cause: A fitted cap supplies the entire silhouette; sparse elliptical lock tubes sit over it. _Braid_Gather is one large tapered sweep, while three circular helices continue as constant-radius tubes without a lobe/contact-aware weave.
critical_requirement_ledger.proposed_source_fix: Sculpt broad primary/secondary hair masses into the fitted cap and vary part, temple and nape flows. Replace the bean gather with overlapping flattened swept bundles converging into the first plait crossing. Build a compact alternating three-lobe braid with intentional contact and flattened elliptical sections, taper toward the tie, and integrate restrained strand grooves into surfaces rather than bright separate cords.
critical_requirement_ledger.acceptance: Profile/back/oblique/root-braid closeups at fixed framing. Hair must remain covered, scalp-fitted, readable at gameplay distance, and connected during allowed head and chest motion.

critical_requirement_ledger.observation: Eyebrows appear as uniform narrow strips with blunt-looking inner ends. Skin is coherent in colour across face/neck/hands, but completely smooth and almost uniform; hair highlights read plastic under the fixed lighting.
critical_requirement_ledger.source_cause: Brows are constant-depth elliptical sweeps. Skin/hair use one constant base colour and roughness per key and no UV or colour-attribute variation. The render's strong broad highlights compound the simple surface forms; no colour-space defect has been established.
critical_requirement_ledger.proposed_source_fix: Fit tapered brow clumps close to skin with a gentle root/body/tip density change and a very restrained upper lash rim. Add a coherent skin colour system with subtle cheek/nose warmth, lip transition and sparse reference-supported freckles; carry that system across ears/neck/hands. Establish medium roughness and fine directional hair variation. Validate neutral/unlit colour before changing global palette or lighting.
critical_requirement_ledger.acceptance: Neutral clay, unlit/base-colour and final-lit face/ear/neck/hand closeups. No front-only texture border, mismatched skin patches, excessive blush or glossy plastic hair.

critical_requirement_ledger.observation: All five digits are visible and count is correct. Full-body images cannot establish webbing, thumb base, knuckle shape or wrist fit reliably. Source inspection proves fingers/thumb are individually capped tubes separate from the capped palm, and all hand vertices are rigid to one hand bone.
critical_requirement_ledger.source_cause: Arin_Palm is a six-ring loft; four fingers and thumb are independent tapered sweeps, with no common palm/web/thenar vertex flow and no individual finger controls.
critical_requirement_ledger.proposed_source_fix: After hand closeups and resolved grip scope, build a continuous palm-to-finger/web surface with joint taper, knuckles, thenar/thumb web and naturally staggered finger lengths. Add three phalange segments per articulated digit only when actual grip support is required. Preserve intentional relaxed spread.
critical_requirement_ledger.acceptance: Both hands/thumbs from palm, dorsal and side closeups; inspect neutral, reaching and potion-grip poses if required. Do not promote this visual check to pass from digit count, names or normalized weights.

critical_requirement_ledger.observation: Overall adult proportions and waist taper are readable, but sleeves and shoulders are broad simplified masses, rear cape is a stiff rectangular slab and waist/coat layers are mechanically shaped. Reference clothing has curved shoulder drape, softer volume transitions and intentional cloth folds.
critical_requirement_ledger.source_cause: Torso/sleeve sections are independent lofts and cape is a short rectangular shell rigid to spine_03. Details decorate these simple forms instead of establishing cloth drape and fitted shoulder transitions.
critical_requirement_ledger.proposed_source_fix: Coordinate the face/head revision with torso/shoulder silhouette. Rebuild cape shoulder/nape drape and garment openings as fitted shell surfaces, refine cloth allowance and gravity/tension folds, and preserve accessory attachment. Body owner should resolve proportion and fit before further decorative detail.
critical_requirement_ledger.acceptance: Matched clay and material full-body front/back/profile/three-quarter plus shoulder/waist closeups and reach/twist poses. No underarm webbing, inflated torso or garment clipping.

critical_requirement_ledger.observation: No static head/neck or limb gap is visible in the reviewed poses, but the back-neck join has a hard level transition and clothing occludes the pelvis. Source uses separate capped neck, palm, pelvis and leg parts; neutral renders cannot prove continuity under reach or extreme bends.
critical_requirement_ledger.source_cause: Independent capped lofts are skinned by position bands; connected bone endpoints and normalized weights do not weld or preserve these surfaces.
critical_requirement_ledger.proposed_source_fix: Inspect evaluated neutral and major joint bends before repair. Create continuous visible skin transitions at neck/wrist and a continuous trouser seat/inseam where required; use supporting joint loops and weighted blending. Retain intentional separate cloth layers and accessories.
critical_requirement_ledger.acceptance: Neck rotation, wrist bend, elbow/shoulder reach, hip/knee bend and twist closeups, including exported deformation. Record visible gaps, collapse and intersections or explicitly keep this criterion unclear.

critical_requirement_ledger.observation: Actual fresh FBX import retains the corrected head/hair placement and full-body profile. No loss of face pieces or scalp coverage is visible.
critical_requirement_ledger.source_cause: The durable builders produce mesh components with actual skinning, and the exporter preserves hierarchy/material assignments for the current candidate.
critical_requirement_ledger.proposed_source_fix: Rerun the same exporter/import inspector after topology, materials, weights or actions change. Preserve prior evidence as baseline rather than overwriting the only copy.
critical_requirement_ledger.acceptance: Fresh-import technical gate report and all current fixed views, plus any new contract poses/closeups, for the final retained source revision.

highest_priority_repair_groups.cause: The primary face form and disconnected skin features are wrong for the requested higher-quality identity; cosmetic texture alone will not solve them.
highest_priority_repair_groups.proposed_change: Build a source-authored continuous quad face around real eye openings and integrated muzzle/nose/lips from the selected reference, with deliberate cheek/jaw/forehead form. Set the required facial deformation contract before loops and rig controls are finalized.

highest_priority_repair_groups.cause: Continuous coverage is solved but cap/lock/gather/braid forms remain primitive.
highest_priority_repair_groups.proposed_change: Reshape cap masses and flow, replace gather, and weave a compact contact-aware plait while preserving scalp coverage and head/chest motion attachment.

highest_priority_repair_groups.cause: Separate capped tube construction and rigid attachments need feature closeups and pose evidence before high-quality acceptance.
highest_priority_repair_groups.proposed_change: Resolve hand grip/rig scope, rebuild palm-web-thumb flow and visible joint transitions, refine cape/garment drape, then run affected poses.

highest_priority_repair_groups.cause: Constant material fields cannot carry the reference's skin and surface richness, and lighting accentuates the simplified masses.
highest_priority_repair_groups.proposed_change: Add coherent export-supported skin variation and restrained texture/roughness detail after shapes pass. Keep all exposed skin as one material system and compare neutral and final-lit evidence.

pending_evidence: New root-selected reference/polish board and final facial/grip/triangle/material/texture contract.
Hands/thumbs, shoulders/underarms, waist/crotch and boots from feature-scale closeups.
Fixed both-side face profiles and top scalp view.
Contract poses beyond the tiny Idle: head turn, major joint bends, reach, twist and actual grip where required.
Final source revision and identical fresh-export/runtime evidence after source repairs.
exclusion: No UE API calls, no Blender execution and no current model source edits were performed for this ledger.
